text:
ana: Customer flagged duplicate invoice for Feb usage. They see two PDFs for same period; one has no embedding lines. Ticket #BILL-9476.
billing-bot: reconcile-daily completed 2025-04-15T07:00:00Z. Alert: duplicate invoices detected for customer_id=SQ-304, period=2025-02.
matt: invoice ids?
ana: INV-2025-12011 and INV-2025-12011-copy. Totals differ by $0.30. INV-2025-12011 (created first) lacks embedding_line_items.
gina: quick logs: during line_items write we saw a DB connection reset; retry path created second invoice record without idempotency key. Snippet: ```
2025-02-28T23:59:59Z ERROR invoice_writer: db connection reset while writing line_items
2025-02-28T23:59:59Z INFO invoice_writer: retrying create (idempotency_key=null)
2025-02-28T23:59:59Z INFO invoice_writer: created INV-2025-12011-copy (no line_items attached to INV-2025-12011)
```
matt: ops asked for immediate remediation to avoid customer confusion. Recommend void duplicate and issue credit, then attach missing lines to canonical invoice.
ops-approval: Approve manual remediation: void duplicate invoice and issue credit up to $5k. Authorize immediate action.
ana: running fix script now: `./scripts/finance/fix_dup.py --dup INV-2025-12011-copy --attach-to INV-2025-12011 --note "created by retry; missing embeddings"`
nana: done  INV-2025-12011-copy voided, credit CR-6145 issued for $2,140.30, missing embedding lines appended to INV-2025-12011, totals recalculated. Customer and CS notified. Ticket updated #BILL-9476.
gina: plan for hotfix: add fallback idempotency using sha256(customer_id + period + usage_checksum) when request_id is absent, make invoice + line_items write transactional, and add an alert for invoices created within same 3-minute window for same customer+period. I'll open PR and include integration tests.
matt: please also ensure money is persisted in integer cents to avoid rounding drift.
nana: closing loop for now  manual remediation complete, refund issued, eng follow-up in PR, postmortem requested. :white_check_mark:
